items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went to work with Tony Bennett and also we toured the entire United States.

ctx.x: Maestro I also understand that you did not get to complete the tour of 52 cities with Stan Kenton. That in the course of a few months you . . .

Well, I went to work with Tony Bennett at the time. I went to work with Tony Bennett and also we toured the entire United States. Then we went to South America, Canada and Venezuela and I recorded with him a number of times too - a huge concert at Carnegie Hall that was recorded. And now in the book on his life which is entitled, Better Life, he mentions my name several times and speaks highly of me and aside from that, he has also included some pictures of me in the book where I appear working with him. That was…
How long were you with Tony?
